claim_boundary: Passing every out-of-fold development gate would authorize only a separately registered frozen-model test stage. It would not itself authorize integration, a default, or a general factuality claim.
purpose: Test whether deterministic claim-to-evidence alignment features can safely recover precision from the pinned MIT FactCG scorer under document-grouped nested cross-fitting.

selection.disclosure: FactCG development outcomes and later provider failures were known before this method was selected. No structured-stack fold, threshold, coefficient, prediction, or aggregate was computed before registration. The runner has no test-path argument and cannot access the sealed test split.
selection.rationale: The prior failures showed that model confidence alone did not separate partial support safely. This fixed trial adds exact sentence-level content alignment, numeric and capitalized anchors, and aligned negation agreement to the commercially usable MIT FactCG score. Exact-document groups cannot cross folds, and each outer decision uses a threshold learned only from inner out-of-fold training predictions.
